summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancements to Spark integration, including updates on Spark 4.1 and 4.2 features. Additionally, proposals for improving read performance, implementing fine-grained access policies, and introducing a first-class Tag concept in the REST Catalog have been actively discussed.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes on integration work
Discussion on leveraging sort order metadata for performance optimizations
Proposal for fine-grained read restrictions in loadTable response
First-class Tag concept in Iceberg REST Catalog
